findings.label: Fewer-than-requested cards pass silently
findings.detail: gerarFlashcards returns however many valid cards parse (sliced to at most N) with no lower bound; a model returning 3 cards for a request of 20 yields 3 with no notice. Deferred to the finishing phase (Task 9 UI) per worklog-task6.md.

findings.label: Clamp-vs-block asymmetry between service and UI
findings.detail: The renderer blocks generation while quantity is out of range, but the service clamps rather than rejects, so the two layers encode different intents for odd input. Harmless today; pick one convention when Task 7 reuses normalizarQuantidade for exercises.
